title: VIDYA-X AI Benchmark Evaluation Dataset
description: Synthetic multi-subject evaluation benchmark dataset covering retrieval, grounded RAG, citations, abstention, quiz quality, personalization, and study planning.
author: VIDYA-X AI Quality Framework

retrieval_cases.jsonl.description: Queries with ground truth chunk IDs for Recall@K, Precision@K, and MRR.

rag_cases.jsonl.description: Grounded answer verification and unsupported question abstention cases.

citation_cases.jsonl.description: Source citation ID resolution, page/slide/timestamp validation, and cross-course boundary cases.

quiz_cases.jsonl.description: Question answer key correctness, MCQ distractor verification, and deduplication cases.

personalization_cases.jsonl.description: Synthetic learner profiles A through H exercising adaptive recommendations and prerequisite priority.

study_plan_cases.jsonl.description: Time budget compliance, exam date boundary, and spaced repetition interval cases.
